description: MainActivity class for an Android Kotlin app implementing Tic Tac Toe UI. It manages rendering the game board, updating status, handling user interactions, and displaying dialogs/snackbars for game outcomes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that serves as the main entry point for the Tic Tac Toe game, rendering UI, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, ViewModel, and event listeners.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the board UI, applying animations on changes and highlighting the winner line.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status TextView with current player's turn or game outcome, with smooth color transition.

methods.name: maybeShowOutcome
methods.description: Displays an outcome dialog when the game is over, with options to restart or close.
